questions.text: Is your manufacturing unit ISO 9001:2015 certified? Attach a valid certificate.
questions.pass_rule: Yes, with a certificate valid on the RFQ deadline and issued to the bidding legal entity

questions.text: Will you provide lot-wise test reports for Box Compression Test (BCT), bursting strength and moisture content?
Monthly corrugation capacity (metric tonnes) and current utilisation (%).
questions.pass_rule: Info only; flag if our monthly volume exceeds 25% of free capacity

questions.text: Standard lead time from PO to delivery at Hosur (days).
Kraft paper source: virgin / recycled / mixed. Is FSC certified paper available on request?
Do you have in-house flexo printing up to 4 colours?
Years of experience supplying consumer durables / appliance OEMs. Name two current customers.
Do you accept our standard payment terms of 60 days from invoice?

questions.pass_rule: Must be present for PO creation

questions.text: Will you replace rejected lots within 7 days at your cost, including freight?

qualification_rule: A vendor is QUALIFIED only if every must-pass question (Q1, Q2, Q8) passes with evidence.
